title: Cambridge Solution Architecture Executable Knowledge — Architecture Genesis

authority.purpose: Provide deterministic requirements-quality, journey-modelling, System Context and lifecycle-transformation rules used by AIW Architecture Genesis.
limitations: This release operationalises the methods needed by rc.10.71; it is not a verbatim reproduction of source course material.
Enterprise policy and project evidence override generic knowledge rules.
Numeric quality targets require user or source confirmation.

requirementQualityRules.name: Explicit actor or responsible artifact
requirementQualityRules.detect: functional requirement lacks actor or system responsibility

requirementQualityRules.name: Measurable quality target
requirementQualityRules.detect: qualitative quality word without measurable response
requirementQualityRules.action: create clarification; never invent latency, throughput, availability, RTO or RPO

requirementQualityRules.name: Failure behaviour
requirementQualityRules.detect: critical capability has no alternate, failure or recovery outcome
requirementQualityRules.action: create journey failure path and architecture obligation

requirementQualityRules.name: Evidence provenance
requirementQualityRules.detect: record has no source, user assertion or approved derivation
requirementQualityRules.action: block approval until origin is explicit

qualityScenarioGrammar.transformation: business concern -> quality attribute -> measurable scenario -> tactic -> architecture obligation -> fitness evidence

completenessRules: Every critical functional requirement is represented by at least one approved journey.
Every external interaction carries an owner, purpose, data exchange and failure obligation.
Critical journeys include a failure or recovery path.
Sensitive data exchanges create security and privacy obligations.
Long-running or asynchronous steps create orchestration, idempotency and observability considerations.

systemContextRules: Exactly one system of interest is explicit per context scope.
Actors and external systems are distinguished from internal responsibilities.
Every major journey participant is represented or explicitly dispositioned.
Context relationships state outcome or information exchanged, not generic connectivity.
Trust, organisational and scope boundaries are visible.
Context objects and relationships preserve requirement and journey lineage.
Internal containers and components are deferred until logical decomposition.

sponsorApproval.basis: explicit user approval in programme conversation

independentReview.scope: method correctness, authority boundaries, unsupported-claim controls, traceability and architecture applicability

promotion.fourEyesStatus: sponsor-plus-independent-AI-review; external human calibration remains required for production scoring
